metadata.change_reason: Product and domain invariant specification quality standard, enforcing comprehensive coverage across state machines, data integrity, access isolation, and UX safety

rules.statement: Invariant suite must fully cover state transitions, data conservation, permission isolation, and user safety dimensions
Every invariant must explicitly bind to PRD entities or state machines
Every invariant must declare explicit severity levels and catastrophic failure consequences
Invariant definitions strictly prohibit unresolved placeholders such as TBD or TODO
